source_snapshot.procedure: Run NVQual/NV Diag for four hours stressing GPU and NVLink switch.
source_snapshot.criteria: Workable, no badblock/SEL error, normal devices/link speed/bandwidth.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Four hours versus 480 minutes, tool and badblock oracle conflict.

old_problem: Four hours conflicts with 480 minutes; NVQual versus NV Diag, non-destructive badblock meaning and link/bandwidth oracles are unknown.
disposition_reason: ED-14 forbids silently changing duration and ED-15 forbids normal-without-threshold PASS. Proprietary tool identity and safe badblock evidence are core semantics.
decision_basis: Preserved GPU/NVSwitch, duration, badblock, SEL and link/bandwidth coverage.

test_case.purpose: Run the approved complete stress suite for the authoritative duration and verify GPU/NVSwitch memory, events, links and bandwidth.
required_package: GPU/NVSwitch roster and non-destructive badblock source
test_case.test_command: After approval, capture baseline, run the pinned suite for full duration under monitoring, collect periodic health/link/bandwidth and final non-destructive memory/SEL evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Full duration completes with no new badblock/error and every device/link/bandwidth metric meets signed limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Four hours and 480 minutes are not interchangeable; workable or tool PASS alone is insufficient.
test_case.recovery: Stop on first health limit, preserve partial logs, cool down and restore services/settings.

source_conflict.reason: Duration and tool identity conflict; acceptance is undefined.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approve duration, tool/config, badblock evidence, thresholds and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: Signed stress duration and acceptance contract.

project_authority: Qualification package and platform thresholds are project-specific.
